resources.string: On your computer, open Codex Desk → Settings → Phone access → Set up phone access. Desk will install and configure the connection for you.

Open Tailscale, sign in with the same account as your computer and switch it on. Accept Android’s VPN prompt, then return here. Your phone can change Wi-Fi or mobile networks without changing the computer address.
Paste the address shown in computer settings. After connecting, enter the pairing code from that same page.
Enter the HTTPS .ts.net address shown by Codex Desk.
Could not reach your computer. Check Tailscale on both devices and keep Desk running on the computer.
The computer’s HTTPS certificate could not be verified. Open Phone access in desktop settings and retry setup.
No app is available to open this link.
